contexts.text: Whatever may be the character of the presiding men of the Church...
When this has invaded the presidents, moderators, and leaders in the Church...

Then comes the overseer of that cavern, and says to them... And their companions say, Our overseer knows what work each one is fitted for... He is (punished) until the overseer sees signs of repentance...
The president of the assembly said...
Where were two presidents of the Church with canons and presbyters under them.
Then one of those presidents... snatched the mitre off his head...
What are they but fables of the ministers and presiding men of the Church...
The reason the presiding men of Christian Churches, and hence their subalterns...
